operations.name: Regenerate ai page
operations.description: Generates a new HTML document from a new prompt and replaces the page with it. Responds with an `application/x-ndjson` stream, one JSON event per line: `start` (`maxOutputTokens`), `heartbeat` (`elapsedMs`, `outputChars`) at least every 10 seconds while the page is generated, then exactly one terminal event - `done` (`page`) or `error` (`code`, `status`, `message`). `code` is `prompt_rejected` (40

prompt.description: What the page should be. The HTML is generated from it and cannot be edited directly

operations.name: Update poll
operations.description: Replaces the poll definition. Existing options are sent as {id, label}, new ones as {label}. A change that removes or reorders options or changes maxChoices needs resetVotes, or is refused with 409 poll_breaking_edit_requires_reset; appending options needs none

maxChoices.description: How many options a voter may pick

resultsVisibility.description: Who sees the results and when

expiresAt.description: End of the poll, epoch milliseconds. null removes the end, omitted keeps it

resetVotes.description: Delete the votes to apply a change that would invalidate them
